text:
Predicates:
Admires(x, y) ::: x admires y.
DesignStyle(x, y) ::: x is a design style of y.
InterestingGeometries(x) ::: x has interesting geometries.
BrutalistBuilding(x) ::: x is a brutalist building.
ZahaHadidStyle(x) ::: x is a style by Zaha Hadid.
KellyWearstlerStyle(x) ::: x is a style by Kelly Wearstler.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
DesignBy(x, y) ::: x is a design by y.
HasDesignStyle(x, y) ::: x has style y.

Premises:
∀x (Admires(x, y) ∧ DesignStyle(y, z) ∧ ZahaHadidStyle(z) → InterestingGeometries(y)) ::: All styles by Zaha Hadid that Max adores have interesting geometries.
∀x (Admires(x, y) ∧ DesignStyle(y, w) ∧ BrutaList(w) ∧ MaxAdores(w) → InterestingGeometries(w)) ::: No brutalist buildings that Max adores have interesting geometries.
∀x (Admires(x, y) ∧ DesignStyle(y, z) ∧ MaxAdmires(z) → (DesignStyle(z, w) ∧ ZahaHadidStyle(w)) ∨ (DesignStyle(z, v) ∧ KellyWearstlerStyle(v))) ::: Every style Max adores is either by Zaha Hadid or Kelly Wearstler.
∀x (DesignStyle(y, v) ∧ MaxAdmires(v) ∧ KellyWearstlerStyle(v) ∧ Evocative(y)) ::: All Kelly Wearstler styles Max adores are evocative.
∀x (DesignStyle(y, v) ∧ MaxAdmires(v) ∧ KellyWearstlerStyle(v) ∧ Dreamy(y)) ::: All Kelly Wearstler styles Max adores are dreamy.
∀x (DesignBy(x, y) ∧ MaxAdmires(y) ∧ InterestingGeometries(x) → BrutaList(x) ∧ Evocative(x)) ::: If Max's design has interesting geometries, then it is a brutalist building and evocative.

Conclusion:
∃x (DesignBy(x, y) ∧ MaxAdmires(y) ∧ BrutaList(x)) ::: A design by Max is a brutalist building.
